items.t: GBI investigates death of 49-year-old man in Homerville
items.x: The Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI) is assisting the Homerville Police Department with a death investigation in Clinch County.

items.t: Widow searches for lost wedding ring when husband dies 3 days after getting married in Las Vegas
items.x: A South Dakota woman is asking for help finding the wedding ring her husband lost in Las Vegas the night they married.

items.t: FSU Police officer honored with Medal of Valor for bravery during fatal shooting
items.x: A Florida State University Police officer is being honored for his bravery during the FSU shooting last year.

items.t: Officer Cody Poppell recognized with Medal of Valor Award
items.x: Florida State University Police Department said Officer Cody Poppell received the 2026 State Law Enforcement Chiefs Association Medal of Valor Award.

items.t: 'How did we get to that place?' Father of deceased hostage speaks out after Israel's elections
items.x: As elections conclude in Israel, a critical issue remaining for families of those killed and taken hostage on October 7th is accountability. Many want an inquiry into internal security failures.

items.t: Valdosta firefighters launch free home safety initiative following two deadly house fires
items.x: The Valdosta Fire Department has launched a community safety initiative “in light of the recent heartbreak and loss” the community has suffered, according to the fire department.

items.t: Cracked: In South Texas, new Congressional lines divide neighbors
items.x: Neighbors on the same street in Corpus Christi, Texas, will soon have different representatives in Congress. A new Republican-drawn map is dividing communities, and some residents aren't happy.

items.t: DeSantis announces $100 million awarded to Florida water resource restoration, expansion projects
items.x: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis announced that $100 million in funds have been awarded to a number of state projects restoring and expanding state water resources.

items.t: ‘They need to be honored’: Dream Flights honor Tallahassee veterans
items.x: Local veterans took to the skies for an unforgettable tour overlooking parts of the capital city, all in a World War II airplane.

items.t: ‘I miss her like crazy’: Loved ones remembering post office worker hit and killed by car
items.x: Loved ones and a Kentucky community are mourning a post office worker who was hit and killed by a car while walking earlier this month.

items.t: Report: Peltola campaign linked to effort to recruit second Dan Sullivan in Alaska Senate race
items.x: Mary Peltola's campaign was involved in efforts to recruit a second Dan Sullivan for Alaska's Senate race, The New York Times reports. The candidate is now on the ballot alongside the GOP incumbent.

items.t: Grandmother not indicted in baby’s death after police say she left him in hot car for 8 hours while she worked
items.x: A Madisonville grand jury declined to indict a Kentucky doctor after her 10-month-old grandchild died in a hot car, police said.

items.t: Ernie Johnson announces this will be his final season on ‘Inside The NBA’
items.x: Ernie Johnson announced he will be stepping down as host of “Inside the NBA” at the end of the season.

items.t: Police department closes its investigation into Hayden Panettiere’s death
items.x: The Greenville Police Department said it has officially closed its investigation into the death of Hayden Panettiere.

items.t: Thomasville earns $1M grant to fund new south Georgia domestic violence shelter
items.x: Thomasville receives $1 million grant from he Georgia Department of Community Affairs to build Halcyon Home's new domestic violence shelter, city officials say.

items.t: Trump says US will beat China in AI as technology emerges
items.x: Artificial intelligence has emerged as the critical sticking point between the U.S. and China. President Donald Trump, who has named it “super intelligence,” insists the U.S. will beat China in the AI competition.

items.t: ‘Star Wars’ executive to take the reins of Olympic and Paralympic ceremonies
items.x: Oscar-nominated producer Kathleen Kennedy has been hired to oversee the opening and closing ceremonies for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and Paralympics.

items.t: Man loses more than $4,000 after scammers spoof father’s number, claim parents are at gunpoint
items.x: Scammers spoofed an Arizona man’s father’s phone number and claimed his parents in Virginia were at gunpoint. He sent more than $4,000 through Apple Pay.

items.t: 8-month-old dies after left alone in running bathtub, police say
items.x: A Virginia woman was arrested after her 8-month-old died after being left unattended in a bathtub, according to authorities.

items.t: Astronomers make startling discovery of a possible dwarf planet beyond Pluto
items.x: Astronomers have spotted a new dwarf planet candidate in the solar system, beyond the orbit of Pluto, which they provisionally named ED138.
